interface.name: bifrost_window_level_manager_v1
interface.description: Lets the shell put a toplevel on the floating level. A floating window stays above the normal windows of the desktop and is raised only within its own band; menus, panels and the menu bar are not affected. The level belongs to the surface: the window server keeps it for the window's next map too.

request.name: set_level

description.summary: set the stacking level of the toplevel of a surface

request.description: Applies at once to a mapped toplevel, and on its next map otherwise.
